verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items address data retention policies, deletion controls, or data export/removal mechanisms for OpenHands Cloud or self-hosted deployments. Being an open-source/self-hostable tool implies data control is possible in principle, but nothing in the evidence documents user-facing retention or deletion settings. Missing for 10: documented data retention policy, deletion/export controls, conversation/log purge options, and any privacy-posture documentation.
